title: Preparing CCMB80 Chemically Competent Cells (TOP10/DHB10)
author: Jennifer Molloy
materials: Aliquot 1 mL samples to Nunc cryotubes
Equipment pH meter Magnetic stirrer Sterile filtration unit Graduated cylinder Weighing balance Beakers (200 ml)

steps.title: Prepare Detergent-Free Glassware
steps.instruction: Autoclave necessary glassware filled 75% with deionised water to remove detergent residue.

steps.title: Prepare CCMB80 Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the buffer in a 200 mL beaker using the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL distilled water and 1 mL of 1 M potassium acetate solution.
Add 1.18 g calcium chloride dihydrate (CaCl2·2H2O), 0.4 g manganese chloride tetrahydrate (MnCl2·4H2O), and 0.2 g magnesium chloride hexahydrate (MgCl2·6H2O).
Add 10 mL glycerol.
Add distilled water to bring the total volume to 100 mL.
Stir with a magnetic stirrer until all solids are completely dissolved.

steps.title: Adjust Buffer pH
steps.instruction: Measure the pH of the solution using a pH meter.

substeps.instruction: If pH is above 7.0, slowly add 0.1 M HCl dropwise while stirring until pH reaches 6.4.
If pH is below 7.0, no adjustment is necessary (do not adjust pH upwards to avoid manganese dioxide precipitation).

steps.title: Filter and Chill Buffer
steps.instruction: Sterilize the buffer and prepare it for use.

substeps.instruction: Filter the buffer through a sterile filtration unit into a sterile container.
Store filtered buffer at 4 °C.
Place 100 mL of CCMB80 buffer on ice or in a -20 °C freezer briefly, then on ice.

steps.title: Prechill Equipment
steps.instruction: Prechill 250 mL centrifuge tubes and screw cap tubes by placing them in a -20 °C freezer or on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Seed Culture
steps.instruction: Generate single colonies and seed stock.

substeps.instruction: Streak TOP10/DH10B cells on an SOB plate and grow at 23 °C or Room temperature.
Pick single colonies into 2 mL of SOB medium and shake overnight at 23 °C or Room temperature.

steps.title: Grow Culture to Target OD
steps.instruction: Inoculate 250 mL of SOB medium with 1 mL vial of seed stock.

substeps.instruction: Grow at 20 °C or Room temperature for approximately 16:00:00 until OD600nm reaches 0.3.
Measure OD with a spectrophotometer or plate reader every 30-60 min starting from 12 hours.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture and remove supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 3000 rpm, 4 °C, for 20 minutes in a flat bottom centrifuge bottle.
Discard supernatant by pouring out slowly and then using a seropipette to remove the remaining liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Perform a wash step to prepare cells for competency.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 80 mL of ice cold CCMB80 buffer.
Centrifuge again at 3000 rpm, 4 °C, for 20 minutes.
Discard supernatant as previously described.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in a small volume of buffer and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 10 mL of ice cold CCMB80 buffer.
Incubate on ice for 00:20:00.

steps.title: Test and Adjust Cell Density
steps.instruction: Verify the OD of the resuspended cells.

substeps.instruction: Test the OD of a mixture containing 200 µL SOC media and 50 µL of the resuspended cells.
Add chilled CCMB80 to yield a final OD of 1.0-1.5 in this test.

steps.title: Final Incubation and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Perform final chilling and distribute cells.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on ice for 00:03:00.
Add glycerol to a final concentration of 15% (v/v).
Aliquot into chilled screw top 2 mL vials or 50 µL into chilled microtiter plates.
[Optional] Place tubes into a zip lock bag and immerse in a dry ice/ethanol bath for 00:05:00.
Place in -80 °C freezer indefinitely.

steps.title: Verify Transformation Efficiency
steps.instruction: Test the competency of the prepared cells using pUC19 plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 pg/μl pUC19 by diluting 1 µL of NEB pUC19 plasmid (1 μg/μl, NEB N3401S) into 100 mL of TE buffer.
Transform 50 µL of cells with 1 µL of the 10 pg/μl pUC19 plasmid in a 1.5 ml or 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate tubes on ice for 00:30:00.
Heat shock tubes in a water bath at 42 °C for 00:01:00.
Add 250 µL SOC media to each tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 01:00:00 (or 02:00:00 for chloramphenicol/tetracycline resistant plasmids) in 2 mL centrifuge tubes, ideally on a lab rotator.
Plate 80 µL on agar plates with appropriate antibiotic using spreaders or sterile 3.5 mm glass beads.
Calculate efficiency: (dilution factor=15) x colony count x 10^5 /µgDNA (Expected: 5x10^8 to 5x10^9 cfu/µgDNA; typical yield 100-400 colonies).
